resolution.note: The named S8 GRX820 block states 700x40C stock tires and compatibility up to 45C. This is a manufacturer claim; actual measured width depends on rim and tire. Reopen trigger: Reopen if SAVA publishes a different exact-S8 maximum or a measured-width basis.
